original_question: Which new sections did the LP-WUS (Low-Power Wake-Up Signal) study TR 38.869 add to TS 38.211 and 38.213? (UE power-saving implementation)
original_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.869'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

evidence.finding: Original LP-WUS tracing is grounded in nine original XML/style pairs, both target TS documents, fifteen independent SQL roles and complete incident evidence for 1,813 recovery nodes. It preserves study assertions, implementation CRs and actual inserted headings as distinct, replayable evidence roles.
evidence.counterauthority: Two seven-unit reviews reconcile the original EN/KR author scope, forward and reverse authored projections, all three study/implementation WI routes, 22 topic CR records including CRPack-only routes, and paragraph-mark source witnesses.
evidence.scope_limits: Classification uses pinned original frozen input; source witnesses, original560 admission and measured model outcomes retain their respective input scopes and denominators.
